policy.example_source: train.jsonl only; no test annotations are demonstrations
policy.selection: SHA256 deterministic ordering of checkpoint groups, then rows; maximize distinct other checkpoints first; no gold labels or comments used in selection
policy.fallback: If only three other checkpoints exist, select a fourth distinct annotated row from one of those checkpoints; never use the target checkpoint
policy.background: once, shared across examples and target; verify exact equality
policy.duplicate_examples: four distinct item IDs and input-context hashes
